mqttBrokerSettings.s_mqtt-broker-connect: Spin up a CamStack-hosted aedes broker on this hub instead of connecting to an external one. Each onboard broker gets its own dedicated server + port.
TCP port for the onboard broker. Leave blank to auto-allocate a free port.
Permit clients to connect without a username/password.

fullSettings.s_mqtt-broker-embedded.desc: Optional CamStack-hosted aedes broker. Enable it to run a broker on this hub without standing up an external one — its connection details are exposed through the `mqtt-broker` cap like any external entry.
fullSettings.s_mqtt-broker-embedded.embe: Starts an aedes broker on this hub. Disabling it shuts the broker down and disconnects clients.
TCP port the embedded broker listens on.
Permit clients to connect without a username/password.
Legacy single-user fallback — used only when no per-client credentials are configured below.
Kept in the keychain. Paired with the shared username above.
fullSettings.s_mqtt-broker-embedded-clie: Per-client username + bcrypt password hash for the embedded aedes broker. Generate the hash with `npx bcrypt-cli` (or any bcrypt tool, cost factor 10) and paste it here.
bcrypt hash of the password (cost factor 10).
Per-user pub/sub allow-list. With zero rules the broker is fully open to authenticated clients. With at least one rule, every user needs at least one rule that matches the topic.
